description: This file implements SAML account linking and validation logic, including functions and classes for verifying SAML IdP authority based on email domains and tenant IDs, with logging and external repository interactions.

classes.name: SamlAccountLinkingService
classes.description: Service class for verifying if a SAML IdP is authoritative for a given email within a specific organization, preventing account takeover.

methods.name: getTeamIdFromSamlTenant
methods.description: Extracts the team ID from a SAML tenant string if it starts with a specific prefix.

methods.name: isSamlIdpAuthoritativeForEmail
methods.description: Checks if the SAML IdP is authoritative for a given email based on domain verification or existing membership.

methods.name: validateSamlAccountConversion
methods.description: Validates whether a SAML account conversion is allowed based on tenant format and IdP authority.
